phaseSplit.method: 48099 wallMs residual: load from read-only plan probe (loadParcelsMs+loadZonesMs=9065); write+verify from 48171 wall residual at same atom count (86499, split 40/60); planMs = wallMs - load - write - verify. 48171 probe: planMs=846, loadMs=5845, wallMs=93190.

rootCause: O(parcels × zones) in-memory point-in-polygon with no spatial index. findZoneAtPoint() linearly scans every bbox-filtered NFHL zone for every parcel centroid and runs full GeoJSON ray-cast (pointInGeoJson) on each zone whose stored bbox contains the point. Cost scales with zone count AND per-zone geometry payload, not atom write volume. County variance (48171 372/s vs 48099 27/s at ~31.5k atoms) tracks plan phase: probe measured planMs 846 vs 1,437,519 (1,700×). NOT the verify seq-scan trap (PK fix confirmed live). NOT per-parcel NFHL SQL (one county-bbox query per run).

Plan probe 48171 vs 48099: planMs 846 vs 1,437,519 (planPct 12.6% vs 99.4%), same ~31.7k atoms; apply wallMs 93,190 vs 1,183,277. Zone count alone insufficient: 48259 fast (320/s) with 1,869 zones; 48505 slow (9/s) with 55 zones but avg 1.58 MB/zone geometry. Harris sizing: 1,523,641 features, 19,934 bbox-filtered zones (13× 48099 zone load).

metroViability.recommendation: DEFER metros until spatial-index code change lands. Harris (1,523,641 features, 19,934 zones) at measured 180 atoms/sec aggregate ≈ 2.35 h IF plan cost matches statewide average — but 48099-class counties run 27 atoms/sec and Harris has 13× the zone load, so realistic worst case exceeds 8 h on plan alone. At fixed rate 800 atoms/sec (fast-county write speed + grid-indexed PIP — optimistic, not parcel-node parity): ≈ 32 min. Do NOT run Harris as-is; Collin 48085 profile (B1 slot) will likely confirm plan-dominated shape.

proposedFix: Add per-county spatial grid index (e.g. 0.01° cells → zone id list) built once after bbox zone load; findZoneAtPoint consults 1–9 cells instead of scanning all zones. Optional: ST_Contains via PostGIS on simplified geometries as follow-on. Instrument write-flood-hazard-fact-county.mjs with planMs/loadZonesMs/writeMs/verifyMs in --out JSON (b1_metro_profile.mjs pattern, without requiring a write sample). Expected gain: slow counties from ~27/s toward fast-county ~340/s on plan; combined ~400–800/s county rate, making Harris ~30–60 min.
riskOfFix: Low–medium. Grid index is localized to flood-hazard-fact/geo.ts + planner; no schema migration. Risk: cell size tuning at county bbox edges; must preserve SFHA-preference tie-break in findZoneAtPoint. PostGIS path adds deployment dependency. Wrong index could miss zone hits — needs unit tests on 48171/48099 parity before metro apply.

cp1.rootCauseHypothesis: O(parcels × zones) linear zone scan per parcel without spatial index; complex MultiPolygon geometries amplify ray-cast cost per (parcel, zone) pair. Explicitly NOT the jsonb verify seq-scan (PK fix believed on main). Alternative: per-parcel NFHL SQL — to be refuted by code read.
cp1.predictedEffectIfWrong: If write/verify were dominant, PK EXPLAIN would show Seq Scan on atoms and atom_did grep would fail — measurable refutation path.
